risks.title: Geopolitical conflicts and sanctions
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical conflicts, notably the Russia-Ukraine crisis, and sanctions against Russian entities can directly impact Mirion's international operations, increase costs, disrupt supply chain, and affect ability to fulfill existing contracts.

risks.title: Inflation and interest rates
risks.score_rationale: Persistent inflation and elevated interest rates impact material and service costs, reduce profitability of fixed-price contracts, and increase Mirion's debt service costs.

risks.title: Global supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain disruptions, trade restrictions, tariffs and embargoes can limit availability of critical components and increase raw material costs for Mirion and its suppliers.

risks.title: Fixed-price contract risks
risks.score_rationale: Mirion executes long-term fixed-price contracts for new nuclear plant projects. Cost underestimation, operational difficulties or changes in conditions can generate significant losses, even with escalation clauses.

risks.title: Regulatory changes
risks.score_rationale: Changes to global regulatory standards and healthcare reimbursement, as well as new qualification requirements, can impact demand for medical products and compliance costs.

risks.title: Government budget cycle dependency
risks.score_rationale: A significant portion of revenue comes from government and military customers (23 of 32 NATO armies). Unpredictable government budget cycles can create short-term volatility.

risks.title: Integration and restructuring risks
risks.score_rationale: Mirion has historically grown through acquisitions. Failure to efficiently integrate acquisitions, realize expected synergies or restructure could impact operating results.

risks.title: Technology and cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: Mirion relies heavily on technology for critical operations and its global technology infrastructure is exposed to cyberattacks and disruptions.

risks.title: Foreign exchange and financial risks
risks.score_rationale: Mirion operates globally with revenues in multiple currencies. Foreign exchange fluctuations, goodwill impairments and commodity cost variations can impact financial statements.

ai_positioning.summary: Mirion Technologies explicitly recognizes industry megatrends including AI and cloud computing, which drive nuclear energy demand. The company emphasizes the increasing possibility that nuclear serves energy needs of data centers and AI applications, presenting significant market opportunity for its nuclear safety solutions.
evidence: MD&A states: 'The emerging megatrends surrounding the power demands of data centers, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence that can be served by Nuclear'
